text: Developed features for aircraft flight-data applications using Java, Python, Go, and Vue.js.
Built SOAR, a highly available AWS application using Spring Boot and Docker to analyze engine performance and deliver real-time alerts.
Built an auditable data-export service to integrate data across platform versions, processing up to 700 reports and 500,000 analytic executions per minute.
Resolved complex data issues across engine registration, analytic workflows, AWS services, and corporate networks for a safety-critical application.
Mitigated application and Docker-container vulnerabilities identified by Qualys, Prisma Cloud, and SonarQube.
Responded to P1 production outages by troubleshooting incidents, mitigating impact, and contributing to root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
Led development of networking and operational features for a cloud-managed 3D-printer fleet, including video streaming, status monitoring, remote command and control, and firmware upgrades.
Led a vendor-data reconciliation project for a client with more than $1 billion in annual sales; the system identified discrepancies and improved auditor efficiency.
Automated site monitoring, analytics collection, development-environment setup, and server maintenance with PHP, Python, and Bash scripts.
Implemented logging and security-scanning controls to support PCI compliance, using Graylog, OSSEC, Zabbix, and Fail2Ban to improve threat detection and response.

Supported a restaurant-management platform serving more than 1,000 locations by monitoring service health with Zabbix, performing security scans, and maintaining AWS auto-scaling rules and server configurations.
Prototyped IoT applications and evaluated AWS Lambda, Angular, React, and Firebase to demonstrate emerging cloud capabilities to the team.
Contributed to IoT hardware prototypes for managing patients during mass-casualty events; the project placed third at the 2014 IPSO Conference.
Contributed to the company's flagship rating and billing system by gathering requirements, preparing a technical proposal, implementing features, and writing unit tests.
Coordinated unit-equipment movement from Fort Campbell to Kandahar, Afghanistan, for deployment.
Served as a firefighter and lead firefighter, leading emergency-response readiness.
Maintained accountability and inventory of sensitive unit equipment.
